beats.event: Grows up in Pondicherry as the zoo manager's son
Adopts the nickname Pi to escape schoolmates' mockery
At 14 practices Hinduism, Christianity, and Islam at once
Family decides to sell the zoo and emigrate to Canada
July 1977: boards the Tsimtsum with the zoo animals
Ship sinks in a storm; his whole family drowns
Escapes onto lifeboat with hyena, zebra, and orangutan
Hyena kills the wounded zebra and Orange Juice
Bengal tiger Richard Parker emerges and kills the hyena
Builds a raft; conditions Richard Parker with food and punishment
Meets castaway who is killed by the tiger
Discovers floating island of carnivorous algae
After 227 days reaches Mexico; Richard Parker vanishes
Tells Japanese officials the alternative human version
Officials choose the animal story: 'so it goes with God'
